question: What is the maximum Energy I can have at once?
span: You can have a maximum of 6 Energy at once.

question: Can I spend zero Energy on an X cost card?
span: You can spend any amount of Energy when playing an X cost card, including 0.

question: When is a player's Block removed?
span: A player's Block is removed at the start of the Player Turn.

question: When is an enemy's Block removed?
span: An enemy's Block is removed at the start of the Enemy Turn.

question: Does Block stop an effect that says lose HP?
span: Block does not prevent "Lose X HP" effects.

question: What happens to Exhausted cards when combat ends?
span: Keep Exhausted cards in a separate pile and return them to your deck at the end of combat.

question: Is there a maximum hand size?
span: No, there is no maximum hand size.

question: Can Curses be Transformed?
span: Curses can't be Transformed.

question: Do copies of a card cost Energy?
span: Copies do not cost Energy to play.

question: Can a copy of a card itself be copied?
span: Copies cannot also be copied.

question: What is the maximum Block a player can have?
span: Block [Block] (Max 20 for players)

question: How many Vulnerable tokens can one enemy have?
span: up to a limit of 3 [Vulnerable] per player or enemy

question: How many Weak tokens can be applied to a target?
span: up to a limit of 3 [Weak] per player or enemy

question: Are Retained cards discarded at end of turn?
span: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of the Player Turn.

question: Can I reroll the die during the same round?
span: One die result determines all die effects for the round!

question: What happens when we run out of tokens?
span: If you run out of tokens, you can't gain or apply more tokens. The effect is ignored.

question: Once a card I Retained leaves my hand, does it still count as having been Retained?
span: Cards have no memory once they leave your hand.
notes: Rewritten from 'Do cards remember that they were Retained?' - unscoped in time, and a card still in hand does remember. Label unchanged.

question: Do Summons flee when the enemy that summoned them dies?
span: No. Unlike the video game, Summons don't "flee" combat when the enemy that summoned them is killed.

question: Can I use Gambling Chip at an Event?
span: Yes. "Once per room" abilities can be used at Events if applicable.

question: Can the Watcher enter Stances using the Prismatic Shard?
span: The Watcher can't enter Stances on the Prismatic Shard.

question: What happens if an effect tries to play a card that cannot be played?
span: If an effect tries to play a card that can't be played, ignore the effect and discard that card instead.

question: Does an Ethereal card in my hand do anything at end of turn?
span: At end of turn, if this card is in your hand, Exhaust it.

question: Do Status and Daze cards stay in my deck after combat?
span: Remove these from your deck at the end of each combat.

question: Is the token limit shared between players?
span: The token limit remains the same, but it is shared between all players.

question: Do I remove Weak and Vulnerable tokens at the end of the round?
span: Nope. See back of rulebook for details.

question: What happens when my draw pile is empty and I need to draw?
span: When your draw pile is empty and you need to draw, your discard pile becomes the new draw pile.

question: How many cards do I draw at the start of my turn?
span: Draw 5 cards.

question: Can I discuss strategy with the other players?
span: Players can discuss strategy, such as which enemies to attack and which players need help.

question: In what order do I resolve a card's effects?
span: Execute the card's printed effects from top to bottom.

question: Where does a Power go after I play it?
span: If it's a Power, instead place it face up in front of you.

question: Can I play a card during the Enemy Turn?
span: Players can play cards, use potions, and activate abilities in any order they choose.

question: Can I look at another player's hand before deciding my play?
span: Players can discuss strategy, such as which enemies to attack and which players need help.

question: Can I choose not to draw my 5 cards at the start of turn?
span: Draw 5 cards.

question: Can I spend Energy after the End of Turn step has begun?
span: When players are done playing cards, the following effects occur:

If a card that draws me cards causes my discard pile to reshuffle into a new draw pile, does that card get shuffled in with the rest?
span: If a card was just played that drew you cards, that card is set aside while you shuffle, then added to the new discard pile.

question: Does an enemy's unused Block carry over into the next round?
span: Enemies lose all of their leftover Block [Block] tokens.

question: If playing a card triggers another ability partway through, does that ability resolve immediately or wait?
span: Any abilities triggered by the card don't take effect until after the card is finished resolving all of its text.

question: Can I discard my hand before the other players are finished playing their cards?
span: All players take these steps simultaneously.

question: If I already have 8 Strength and play a card that grants more Strength, do I gain the extra?
span: A player can have a maximum of 8 [Strength].

question: For a card that cares about cards "containing Strike," does a card need the literal word "Strike" printed in its name, or just deal Strike-type damage?
span: A card that "contains Strike" has the word "Strike" somewhere in its name.

question: When I Exhaust a Status card, does it go to my personal exhaust pile like other cards?
span: Daze [Daze] and Status [Status Green]/[Status Red] cards return to their respective piles when Exhausted.

question: Can I play a Shiv from my hand the way I'd play a normal card?
span: Shivs don't count as cards.

question: If I'm already at my 5-Shiv maximum and gain another Shiv, can I use it to deal damage immediately instead of losing it?

question: Can Miracle tokens push my Energy above the normal 6 maximum?
span: You can use Miracles to go over the Energy limit (max 6) if they are immediately used to pay for a card.

question: Is the 30-Poison cap applied per enemy, or shared across every enemy in the fight?

question: Can I strip Poison tokens off an enemy before it dies to reduce the damage it'll eventually take?
span: Don't remove Poison [Poison] tokens from an enemy until they are dead.

question: If all of the Defect's Orb slots are full and I Channel another Orb, is the new Orb lost?

question: Do the Defect's Orbs rotate through slots and have to be Evoked front-to-back, like in the video game?
span: No, no, and no. You can Channel an Orb into *any* empty Orb slot, and you can Evoke *any* Orb you have. All Orb slots are treated the same.

question: Does the Watcher take damage for ending her turn in Wrath Stance?

notes: Rewritten from 'sit in Wrath for the rest of combat without any downside?' - compound, and mislabeled forbidden. The book permits staying in Wrath and prices it; it does not withhold permission.

question: If I'm already in Calm Stance, can I 're-enter' Calm to refresh an on-enter effect?
span: You cannot enter a Stance you are already in (the effect is ignored).

question: When multiple enemies share a row, do they act in a specific left-to-right order?

question: Can I hand a spare Relic to a teammate who could use it more?

span: Each player can only do this once per Merchant room.

question: If an Event asks me to "Give" something I don't currently have, can I still pick that option?

question: Can two different players both choose the same bracketed option on an Event card?

question: What is the manufacturer's suggested retail price for this game?

question: Do we set up a 1st Encounter deck again when we start Act II?

question: Do Defect Orbs stack with Vulnerable?
span: (Note: "damage" effects aren't hits.)
notes: Known multi-hop gap, not a chunking bug. Vulnerable only doubles damage from a 'hit' (page 24); the Defect's Orb End of Turn/Evoke text (page 16) never uses the word 'hit', and the one FAQ that touches Orb math calls it 'a Dark Orb's damage' (page 18) rather than a hit. The correct answer - no, Orb effects are 'damage', not 'hits', so Vulnerable doesn't double them - requires chaining those three spans across three pages/sections; no single chunk states it. Reported by the user as a live production miss. Added as a regression probe; not yet fixed.
